public_scope_limit: The historical runner and run ledger are redistributed. The original row-level N-to-2N harmonization result JSONs and the original v17/v18 lock/comparison/closure files are not redistributed in this public repository; therefore no public row-level reproduction claim is made for the historical schedule-lock decision.
terminology_note: The historical seed-42 development audit did not use a prespecified numerical convergence threshold. The later POINT_3_5 audit summary reports observed selected-attack-loss changes up to 0.00410 for retained configurations and at least 0.00579 for configurations that were extended; these are empirical separation values, not an a priori 0.005 criterion. The manuscript therefore does not present 0.005 as a prespecified selected-attack-loss threshold.
